diagnosis: The proof repeats the same append/subset transitivity argument for every recursive constructor. Those branches can be discharged uniformly after destructing the normalization witness and unfolding List.Subset, while retaining the special handling required for applications representing old expressions.
proof_body:
by
  intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at * <;>
    try simp_all
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intros x Hin
      exact Hin
    · next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
        exfalso
        specialize Hn ?_
        constructor
        cases Hn
        apply Hfalse
        rfl
    · cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
        apply List.Subset.app
        · exact List.Subset.trans (fn_ih H1) (by simp_all)
        · exact List.Subset.trans (e_ih H2) (by simp_all)
  all_goals
    cases Hnorm
    simp_all [List.Subset]
